title: SF MONSTERS
status: Unreviewed SF chapter with Cognition, three original starter/call candidates and an original Sunset theme; wild creatures, evolution art, portraits and other music remain placeholders.

intro.gText_Birch_Welcome: Welcome to SAN FRANCISCO!\pI'm NAVAL. The fog got here\nbefore either of us.\pAround here, even tiny monsters\nhave a personal brand.\p$
intro.gText_Birch_Pokemon: This is a MINI MONSTER.\pIt does not need a pitch deck.\p$
intro.gText_Birch_MainSpeech:
SF is home to MINI MONSTERS.
They live beside all of us.\pYou can recruit a team, explore
neighborhoods, and battle.\pEight startup gyms will test
your strategy and teamwork.\pA strange signal is disturbing
the city's fog and habitats.\pBegin in the OUTER SUNSET.
Follow the missing prototype.\p$
intro.gText_Birch_YourePlayer: Right, {PLAYER}!\pYour new home is in\nthe OUTER SUNSET.\pThe rent includes the fog.\p$
intro.gText_Birch_AreYouReady: Ready for your SF adventure?\pFind a companion. Explore.\nRead the signs. Talk to people.\pSome of them may be normal.\pWatch for the fog signal.\nIt is not a product launch.\p$
